description: This file is a C source file configuring the Operating System (OS) module for an embedded system based on the MPC5604P microcontroller. It includes definitions for application setup, counters, alarms, tasks, hooks, ISRs, and other OS components.

methods.name: GEN_APPLICATION
methods.description: Defines an application with specific parameters such as ID, name, trusted status, core, and hooks.

methods.name: GEN_COUNTER
methods.description: Defines a counter used for timing and alarm management.

methods.name: GEN_ALARM
methods.description: Defines an alarm linked to a counter with start type, delay, and associated task or event.

methods.name: GEN_BTASK
methods.description: Defines a basic task with priority, schedule policy, autostart, and application ownership.

methods.name: GEN_ETASK
methods.description: Defines an extended task with event mask and related parameters.

methods.name: GEN_HOOKS
methods.description: Sets up various OS hooks such as startup, shutdown, error, pre/post task hooks.
